title.description: What `pikit new` shows if it asks which preset to start from.

ui.description: Install the dashboard by default, as `pikit new --ui` does. Inherited by aliases.

kind.description: Every registry component of this kind answers; the one in `components` is the default. A multiple choice may have no default.

multiple.description: Several answers at once (a channel: any of them; a router: one), all of them replacing the listed one. Default: false.

choose.description: One question of `pikit new` per entry; `--with <component>` answers it in a script.

tools.description: `agent.tool` keys (`bash`), each provided by a chosen component with its default config (its component.json `replay.tools`).

extensions.description: `agent.extension` keys (`pikit-self`), each provided by a chosen component with its default config (its component.json `extensions`).

steward.description: What the starter agent, the steward, is granted, by key, whatever is chosen: nothing is granted because a component is installed. `pikit new` checks each key against the chosen components before writing. Inherited by aliases.

config.description: A component's config entry in pikit.config.ts, by its name, plain values only, written when that component is chosen (`router-basic: { defaultAgent: steward }`). Each a component the preset can choose: of `components`, an answer to `choose`, or of a feature. Inherited by aliases.

feature.description: The feature (its first component's name) that keeps agents in folders.

command.description: The command that feature's first component declares (`commands`), which `pikit new` runs once to write the agents' registry.

agents.description: The agent layout: `pikit new` asks one agent or several, and with several chooses `folders.feature`, writes the steward's SYSTEM.md and runs `pikit <command>`. Inherited by aliases.

components.description: What choosing it installs: offered by the first's `title` and named by it (`--with <first>`).

ui.description: Choosing it brings the dashboard, as `--ui` does. Default: false.

tools.description: `agent.tool` keys (`bash`), each provided by a chosen component with its default config (its component.json `replay.tools`).

extensions.description: `agent.extension` keys (`pikit-self`), each provided by a chosen component with its default config (its component.json `extensions`).

steward.description: What choosing it grants the steward too, shown before it is chosen.

features.description: What `pikit new` offers to add, several at once, each shown by its first component's component.json `title` (with the dashboard, which `--ui` adds); `--with <first>` adds one in a script. Named by its first component, once each; none in `components`, and of no kind the preset `choose`s.

model.description: The starter agent's model, `<provider>/<modelId>`: a component of the preset provides its provider (`pikit new` checks it before writing). Default: the CLI's for the target (`anthropic/…` on a server, `openrouter/…` on Cloudflare).

title.description: What `pikit new` shows if it asks which preset to start from.

extends.description: The base preset: an alias of an alias is refused.

with.description: Answers to the base's questions, as `--with` gives them.

title: pikit preset
description: A preset of a pikit registry: a base, or an alias of one.
